stem.text: Which diagram shows the pattern of the electric field lines due to a negative point charge?

A.alt: Field-line diagram: a central dot with straight radial lines and arrowheads along them.

B.alt: Field-line diagram: a central dot with straight radial lines and arrowheads along them.

C.alt: Field-line diagram: a central dot with concentric circular lines and arrowheads along them.

D.alt: Field-line diagram: a central dot with concentric circular lines and arrowheads along them.
